digest.component_or_area: workflow editor server and policy projection
propositions: The workflow editor must expose both the authored YAML/BPMN topology (editable) and an Effective Policy view (read-only) derived from CriteriaSnapshot, preventing the effective view from becoming a second policy authority.

Project code-review LLM criteria require a non-empty list of non-empty repository-relative applies_to globs at authoring/save validation, with rejection and remediation hint for missing or empty selectors.

Effective Policy data includes criterion id, gate, execution tier, posture, applicability summary, enabled/disabled state, and derived reason sourced from snapshot digest, never from execution trace or debugging detail.
A CriteriaSnapshot load or validation failure must mark the Effective Policy unavailable with a located, actionable error rather than silently displaying packaged defaults.
The authored workflow serialization remains byte-equivalent across rollout and rollback; policy changes update only the read-only derived view.
Built-in triggers, project DET criteria, and plan-review criteria retain their distinct trigger authoring controls and are exempt from the project-LLM applies_to glob enforcement.
